title: Handoff: recovered Buddy run queue stall, fix and integration follow-ups
summary: Owner supplied an incident handoff and asked Product Development Lead to take it forward. One reply reports the live stall recovery (index added, 25 duplicate schedule runs coalesced, server restarted, broken cross-worktree vendor links repaired) and says commit 337da24 has regression coverage and passed 37/37 Rust tests. This review verified that 337da24 and handoff commit 2fe67e6 exist on branch fix/run-active-buddy-index-20260930 in the current checkout; 337da24 is not contained in any other branch shown here. Four Release Engineer follow-up Tasks remain open: integrate/rebuild 337da24, surface claim/drain failures, prevent cross-worktree node_modules links, and unify index definitions. A separate active restart durability project and task cover queued chat turns surviving restart. The handoff is actionable but not delivered through integration, and its claimed live recovery and test run were not independently reproduced in this read-only review.
